name: Creative Kids Summer
description_short: A half-day art camp from 9:00 am to noon at Spring Glen School in Hamden for children in kindergarten through grade 6, sponsored by Hamden Recreation and taught by a retired Hamden teacher and the school's art teacher. Each week children make art on a theme, read fiction and nonfiction books about it, and play outside.

sessions.name: Week 1: Art Based on Children's Books

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Creative Kids flyer posted on the Town of Hamden site. Grades K to 6, including children entering K and children finishing grade 6. $275 per week includes tuition and materials; a $25 deposit per week holds a space.
Researched by Claude from this page. Spring Glen Elementary School home page (Hamden Public Schools), which gives the school's address. The flyer names Spring Glen School as the camp's place.
